basic_info.description: Modern condominium residence with parking and private outdoor space in desirable Lower Pacific Heights neighborhood. Situated in a most quiet part of a well-maintained building. This tranquil retreat is in the heart of the vibrant city. Upon entering, you're greeted by a welcoming atmosphere accentuated by warm natural light streaming in through large windows. The living space is thoughtfully designed, with an open layout that maximizes functionality without sacrificing style. Gourmet kitchen features Thermador refrigerator and Bosch stainless steel appliances, caesarstone quartz counters and generous cabinets. In-unit laundry with Bosch stacking washer and dryer. The bedrooms are peaceful sanctuaries, providing a restful atmosphere. The bathrooms with sleek modern finishes are the perfect place for morning and night routines. The building's amenities include concierge, fitness gym, club room, community roof deck and landscaped courtyard. UCSF Medical Center and Kaiser, plus plethora shops, restaurants and cafes on trendy Divisadero are all nearby. A wonderful next home awaits you!
